title: Bootstrap path wipes production gh-pages branch
issue: On clone stderr containing 'remote branch gh-pages not found', deploy re-inits a fresh orphan branch and pushes ONLY data_direct.json + thumbs + .nojekyll. The fresh branch has no data.json, no index.html, no archives, so pushing it takes production Pages offline. Trigger is a stderr-substring match and the plan never authorizes bootstrapping; it directly violates IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN 1.3 ('production data.json remains 100% untouched', 'commit and push without deleting legacy files').
remediation_spec: Delete the bootstrap branch. On any non-zero clone: logger.error(...); return False with operator message ('gh-pages branch missing on remote; restore from backup, refusing to recreate'). If a fresh-remote flow is ever wanted, require an explicit --bootstrap-pages flag AND seed the new branch with local data.json + index.html + .nojekyll, never direct-only.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Removed the destructive fresh orphan branch bootstrap from site_builder.py deploy_direct_to_gh_pages. On clone failure or missing remote branch, fails closed with clear error log and returns False.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Updated test_direct_stream_mode.py to assert deploy failure and verify git init is never invoked.

title: No MIN_DEPLOY count gate on direct manifest; 60% quorum is vacuous
issue: write_direct_manifest DROPS every invalid item, so every item in a writer-produced data_direct.json trivially satisfies is_direct_stream_url(video_url); good == len(items) always and the quorum always passes for any non-empty manifest. Meanwhile _deploy_only gates on the PRE-drop digest count, not the POST-drop manifest count. Legacy digests contain cdn-less R2-backed items (extractor fallback sets video_cdn_url='' while the browser download still succeeds), so a shrunken (even 1-item) data_direct.json deploys. Phone-side impact is severe: iOS purges the old week on 'Download Week', then bulk-caches a shrunken manifest and the user loses the week offline with no recovery. Violates REQUIREMENTS section 2 (250-reel parity).
remediation_spec: In deploy_direct_to_gh_pages, after loading direct_manifest and before overlay: items = payload.get('items',[]); if len(items) < MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS: log error and return False. Import the floor from main or config (ceil(0.6*TOP_DIGEST_COUNT)). Also change _deploy_only in direct mode to count config.direct_manifest_file() items instead of the digest batch.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Added MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS floor validation on data_direct.json items in deploy_direct_to_gh_pages before git overlay. Updated _deploy_only in main.py to count items from config.direct_manifest_file() instead of raw digest batch in direct mode.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Updated tests to provide minimum item count in test manifests and verify rejection when below floor.

Apply identically to both thumbnails URLs. Add a test passing repo='bad repo' asserting throw, not crash.

title: Rollover purge deletes preserved bookmark thumbnails (.thumb.jpg)
issue: Step 2 claims 'Clear legacy isolated Bookmarks MP4s' but deletes every file using deletingPathExtension() once. For 'abc.thumb.jpg' the stem becomes 'abc.thumb', which never matches protectedStems ('abc'), so ALL bookmark thumbnails are wiped each rollover. Add test: seed Bookmarks/{id}.mp4 + {id}.thumb.jpg with a BookmarkItem row, run executeRolloverPurge, assert .thumb.jpg survives.

title: BookmarkPlayerOverlay plays stale persisted CDN URL with zero failure detection
issue: loadVideo prefers bookmark.videoUrl (a Meta signed URL persisted at bookmark time by BookmarkController.add), which 403s after ~72h. Only AVPlayerItemDidPlayToEndTime is observed; there is NO AVPlayerItemFailedToPlayToEndTime observer and no AVPlayerItem.status monitoring, so an expired URL (online) or any remote URL (offline in MRT, bypassing the honest 'Online required' path entirely) stalls forever on a black screen with isPlaying=true and a ticking fake clock. Contradicts plan 4.2 and REQUIREMENTS section 4.
remediation_spec: After creating item in playMedia, add a second observer for .AVPlayerItemFailedToPlayToEndTime that clears the stale-URL path and re-enters the resolver branch (refactor lines 914-958 into playViaResolver(for:)). Also gate the stored-URL branch on reachability: if let directURL = bookmark.videoUrl, Reachability.isConnectedToNetwork() -- else fall to offline badge / resolver branches. Remove both tokens in teardownPlayer/loadVideo.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In BookmarksSheet.swift, gated stored-URL playback on Reachability.isConnectedToNetwork(), falling through to resolver/offline badge if disconnected. In playMedia, added failObserverToken for .AVPlayerItemFailedToPlayToEndTime and statusObserver on AVPlayerItem.status so expired stored URLs immediately fall back to playViaResolver(for: bookmark). title: write_direct_manifest crashes with TypeError on non-string candidate
issue: candidate = it.get('video_cdn_url') or it.get('video_url') or '' then (r2_dom and r2_dom in candidate). If either field is a truthy non-string (int, list, dict from corrupt checkpoints/hand edits), 'in' raises TypeError, crashing build_site AFTER index/share/archive writes but before manifest write, leaving site/ inconsistent. is_direct_stream_url correctly returns False for non-str, but the 'in' check runs first and is unguarded.

Add regression test with {'id':'x','video_cdn_url':12345} and {'id':'y','video_url':['https://fbcdn.net/a.mp4']} asserting drop-not-crash.

title: Truthy-preference cdn-or-url shadows a valid fallback URL in 4 sites
issue: Four filters select by truthiness, not validity: cand = reel.get('video_cdn_url') or reel.get('video_url') or '' (site_builder.py:103; main.py:2264, 2874, 2969, 3023). A non-empty but INVALID video_cdn_url (R2 URL, expired-format, garbage) shadows a VALID video_url, so the reel is dropped as unplayable despite a playable URL existing. Replace all four selection sites with it. Log dropped ids with both field values at debug.

title: --expand in direct mode deletes expired existing reels and saves without MIN gate
issue: The combined filter drops EXISTING digest items whose Meta URLs no longer format-validate, then ranker.save_digest_batch(combined_items) unconditionally overwrites the live digest AND digests/<week>.json. A routine +3 expand days after sync can turn a 250-item digest into ~53 items. Legacy expand never drops existing items. No --force guard, no pre-save count check (the MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS check only runs when deploy=True). Silent apart from one warning line.
remediation_spec: After filtering: if len(combined_items) < MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS: write expand checkpoint of new_ranked; logger.error('refusing to clobber digest: %d < %d'); return 2 BEFORE save_digest_batch. Separately, preserve expired existing items as metadata (mark 'playable': False) instead of deleting, or require explicit --prune-expired to drop them.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In main.py _run_expand, preserved existing items with unplayable/expired CDN URLs marked with playable: False, and added MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS count gate before saving the expanded batch.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Prevents dropping historical items and ensures shrunken expanded digests do not overwrite healthy live digests.

title: Sync direct-mode shrink saved without MIN gate when deploy=False
issue: The post-URL-filter list is only gated by 'if deploy and len < MIN' (line 2415). A manual --sync without --deploy that drops 240/250 to URL expiry saves a 10-item digest over the healthy live batch (zero-playable guard only catches exactly 0). The pre-filter shortfall gate (line 2215) is voided because direct filtering runs AFTER it. Weekly cron passes --deploy so cron is covered; interactive runs are not.
remediation_spec: Gate the save independent of deploy in direct mode: if len(ranked_reels) < MIN_DEPLOY_ITEMS: _write_sync_progress('shortfall_paused', {'ranked': pre_filter_list, ...}); _alert_sync_abort(...); return 2 before save_digest_batch. Capture the pre-filter list (see AUDIT-053).

maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Guarantees dry/no-deploy sync runs cannot save shrunken batches below floor.

title: build_site clobbers video_url with R2 URLs BEFORE the direct writer runs
issue: The R2-annotation loop overwrites item['video_url'] (and item['r2_url']) on raw_items for every item, then write_direct_manifest(raw_items, ...) is called on the MUTATED copies (lines 571-574). The writer only survives because it prefers video_cdn_url. Any item lacking video_cdn_url but carrying a valid Meta video_url (legacy cdn-less items, hand-fixed digests) has its only good URL destroyed before the writer sees it and is then dropped. Fragile implicit coupling; the writer input contract is 'validated items', not 'R2-annotated items'.
remediation_spec: Snapshot pristine items at the top of build_site: pristine = [dict(i) for i in digest_data.get('items',[])], and call write_direct_manifest(pristine, week_id=week_id, extra_manifest=extra). Never pass R2-annotated raw_items to the direct writer.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In site_builder.py build_site, snapshotted raw pristine items before any in-place R2 URL mutations so write_direct_manifest receives clean, un-mutated reels.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Eliminates R2 URL leakage into direct manifests and viewer data structures.

title: Thumbnail prune deletes PRODUCTION thumbnails when remote data.json is unreadable

Prune must fail closed.
remediation_spec: try: p_items = ...; except Exception: logger.error('prod manifest unreadable; skipping thumbnail prune'); skip the unlink loop entirely. Same fail-closed if the local direct manifest is unreadable. Only prune when BOTH manifests parsed.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In site_builder.py deploy_direct_to_gh_pages, fail-closed thumbnail pruning now strictly requires both production data.json and direct data_direct.json to be valid before executing prune; if remote data.json is missing or corrupted, deploy aborts without deleting thumbnails.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Prevents wiping production thumbnails during direct deploys.

title: ~/.env silently overrides repo .env/branch defaults, with no startup mode log
issue: New loader reads ~/.env FIRST with 'if k and k not in os.environ': home wins over repo .env for every colliding key. A stale DIRECT_STREAM_MODE=false in the home file would silently flip this branch into LEGACY mode, including the destructive pre-upload R2 purge, with zero logging. main.py logs the cookie mode but NEVER logs the effective DIRECT_STREAM_MODE or its source, so the operator cannot tell which pipeline ran.
remediation_spec: (a) Reverse precedence to repo-first: iterate (ENV_FILE, USER_ENV_FILE) so the repo file wins, or at minimum (b) log at startup in _main_inner before any mutation: logger.info('DIRECT_STREAM_MODE=%s (env %s)', config.DIRECT_STREAM_MODE, os.getenv('DIRECT_STREAM_MODE','<unset; branch default>')). Prefer both.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In config.py, reversed .env precedence order so local repository .env overrides ~/.env, and added startup mode logging in main.py reporting active DIRECT_STREAM_MODE and its origin.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Ensures branch and repository environment configs take precedence over system user defaults.

title: Migration records bookmarks for FAILED downloads and uploads without size validation
issue: The try around s3.download_file + gh release upload catches failure and logs, but execution FALLS THROUGH to build/append the bookmark record with video_asset_name pointing at a missing release asset (and size_bytes copied from the R2 manifest regardless). No st_size > 0 check and no comparison against the manifest size_bytes, so a 0-byte/torn download becomes a permanent broken asset via --clobber. bookmarks.json then references ghosts.
remediation_spec: continue on download/upload exception (do not append); after download, sz = local_file.stat().st_size; if sz <= 0 or (item.get('size_bytes') and sz != item['size_bytes']): log error; continue. Collect failures and exit non-zero with a retry list when any fail.

title: Duplicate-tap guard covers .preparing only; tap during .downloading restarts batch

remediation_spec: switch self.state { case .preparing, .downloading, .paused: return; default: break }. If a restart affordance is wanted, require explicit cancel-then-start (separate button), never implicit restart.

title: Preflight overestimates reclaimable bytes (includes pinned Bookmarks + protected files)
issue: calculateReclaimableRolloverBytes sums the Bookmarks dir and all old-week files, but executeRolloverPurge preserves LivePinSet/bookmark copies. Preflight can green-light a batch that will not fit post-purge. It skips only safeIncoming and ResumeData; Bookmarks counted as reclaimable.

Personal-scale alternative: exclude Bookmarks dir only; document that pinned week files are negligible.

maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Preflight accurately estimates storage without falsely treating preserved bookmarks as reclaimable space.

title: 403/410 refresh has concurrent-refresh race and breaks sticky user pause
issue: Two 403s in flight: first sets hasRefreshedManifestForExpiredURLs=true and suspends; second sees flag true and calls cancelAllRemainingAndFail, clearing the queue while the first refresh is still awaiting. When the first completes it re-appends and resumes a failed batch. Separately, the success path calls resumeQueue() unconditionally, lifting an explicit user pause (violates the sticky-pause invariant in suspendQueue).
remediation_spec: Add private var isRefreshingForExpiry = false; in handleExpiredURLResponse: guard !isRefreshingForExpiry else { failedInBatch+=1; return }; set true on entry, false on every exit; re-check state==.failed before mutating queue. On success: if suspensionSource == .user { update queue, stay paused } else { resumeQueue() }.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Introduced isRefreshingForExpiry atomic flag gate in handleExpiredURLResponse, re-checked state == .failed before modifying queue, and preserved explicit user pause intent (priorSuspensionSource == .user).
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Prevents duplicate concurrent manifest refreshes and avoids lifting user-directed pauses.

title: Direct-mode remove deletes a bound (playing) file; legacy path defers, direct does not
issue: Direct remove unlinks bookmarkFileURL synchronously with no activeVideoPool check. Unbookmarking the playing reel stalls AVPlayer. Legacy path routes through deleteBookmarkFile, which defers via pendingDeletions.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Routed direct-mode video deletion through MediaCacheManager.shared.deleteBookmarkFile(reelID:) inside an asynchronous task so that reels actively bound in AVPlayerPool are safely deferred via pendingDeletions.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Eliminates AVPlayer stalls when removing bookmarks for currently playing videos.

title: Count cap is not LRU, can kill the playing video, and Unlimited (0) is coerced to 50
issue: (a) Sorts by bookmarkedAt, evicting long-saved but recently watched favorites; legacy byte-cap correctly uses lastAccessedAt. (b) No activeVideoPool skip, unlike ensureSpaceForBookmark: can delete the playing video. (c) try? removeItem then unconditionally marks evicted (phantom eviction bypasses cap on failure). (d) cap>0 ? cap : 50 maps explicit 0 to 50, although Settings offers 'Keep All Videos' (.tag(0)) and saveSettings treats 0 as unlimited: every bookmark add evicts isolated Bookmarks/*.mp4 beyond 50 against the explicit choice. Direct mode DOES write isolated copies (lines 90-95), so this is a live data-loss path, not muted.
remediation_spec: Distinguish unset from explicit-0: let cap = UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey:'max_cached_bookmark_videos') as? Int ?? 50; enforceCachedVideosCap(limit: cap, ...) with guard limit > 0 else { return } for unlimited. Descriptor: SortDescriptor(.lastAccessedAt, order:.reverse). In loop: fetch bound IDs once and skip; guard (try? removeItem) != nil else { keep .cached; continue }; verify !fileExists before marking evicted.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Distinguished unset cap (default 50) from explicit 0 (unlimited), sorted by SortDescriptor(\.lastAccessedAt, order: .reverse), skipped bound reels from AVPlayerPool.shared.boundReelIDs, and verified file unlinking before updating localStatus to .evicted; verified with testBookmarkControllerEnforceCapLRUAndZeroUnlimited.

title: Resolver maps every URLError to .offline (hides programmer error and cancellation)

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Pattern matched urlError.code in BookmarkResolver: genuine network loss/timeout maps to .offline, .cancelled / .userCancelledAuthentication maps to .failed("Task cancelled"), and all other errors map to .failed(urlError.localizedDescription); verified with testBookmarkResolverURLErrorMapping.

title: Rollover resume runs in detached Task after caller proceeds (suspension race)
issue: defer cannot await, so resume is Task { await handler?(false) }. startDownloadAll awaits purge then immediately drains the queue while suspension may still hold (or isPurging=false while still suspended). freeBookmarkStorage resumes explicitly and has no race; the two methods are inconsistent.
remediation_spec: Drop defer-Task; wrap body with explicit resume before each return (single return here, so one resume at end): isPurging = true; await downloadSuspensionHandler?(true); ... body ...; await reconcileBookmarkStorageLedger(); isPurging = false; await downloadSuspensionHandler?(false).

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Removed detached Task defer block in executeRolloverPurge; synchronously awaited downloadSuspensionHandler?(false) and ledger reconciliation on exit; verified with testExecuteRolloverPurgeSynchronousResume.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Eliminates suspension race condition when caller resumes downloads after purge.

title: deleteBookmarkFile decrements ledger before verifying deletion
issue: Ledger subtracts size, then try? removeItem. A failed unlink leaves bytes on disk but uncounted, letting the 1.5GB cap drift. freeBookmarkStorage already implements verify-before-evict; this method predates it.
remediation_spec: Capture size BEFORE delete; try? fm.removeItem(at: bookmarkDestURL); if !fm.fileExists(atPath: bookmarkDestURL.path) { self.totalBookmarkBytes = max(0, self.totalBookmarkBytes - size) } else keep counted and row stays .cached.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Captured file size before removal, attempted removal, and verified !fm.fileExists(atPath:) before subtracting size from totalBookmarkBytes; returns early if deletion failed; verified with testDeleteBookmarkFileVerifiesDeletionBeforeLedgerDecrement.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Prevents storage ledger drift when unlinking fails.

title: Sheet-chaining via fixed 0.35s asyncAfter can drop the second presentation
issue: Bookmarks->Download, Settings->Download/Manifesto all use DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.35) to present the next sheet after dismiss (lines 435-448, 461-470). If the dismiss animation runs long (slow device, accessibility reduced-motion timings), SwiftUI ignores the second present and the user lands back on the feed with no feedback.
remediation_spec: Chain on state, not time: e.g. .onChange(of: showBookmarksSheet) -> if just dismissed && pendingDownloadSheet { showDownloadSheet = true; pendingDownloadSheet = false }, setting the pending flag in the trigger closures.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: Replaced fixed 0.35s asyncAfter sheet chaining with state-based PendingSheet enum (cases .download, .manifesto). When first sheet dismisses, onChange presents the queued pending sheet without animation drop.

title: Simulator boot fails if device already booted; IPA packaging lacks fail-fast
issue: (a) xcrun simctl boot '$DEVICE_ID' exits non-zero with 'Unable to boot device in current state: Booted' if already booted: one stale state flakes the whole job (line 55). (b) APP_PATH=$(find ... -name '*.app' | head -n 1) followed by bare cp -R '$APP_PATH' Payload/ (line 118) produces an obscure cp error when the build yields no .app (empty var), instead of a clear diagnostic.
remediation_spec: xcrun simctl boot '$DEVICE_ID' 2>/dev/null || true (or check state via simctl list first). [ -n '$APP_PATH' ] && [ -d '$APP_PATH' ] || { echo 'no .app found under build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/'; exit 1; }.

maker_execution.remediation_summary: In .github/workflows/build-ipa.yml, made xcrun simctl boot tolerate already-booted simulators via 2>/dev/null || true, and added a fail-fast validation check on $APP_PATH ([ -n "$APP_PATH" ] && [ -d "$APP_PATH" ]) before Payload packaging.
maker_execution.ripple_effects_and_compiler_fixes: Eliminates simulator boot flakiness in CI and provides explicit diagnostic errors if the release build does not produce an app bundle.
